render_rgb_depth_frames: render RGB and depth map frames from a Local TensoRF model using camera poses and ray IDs
render_test_with_metrics: render test frames and compute MSE and SSIM metrics against ground truth RGB images
render_optical_flow_comparison: render forward and backward optical flow comparisons between predicted and ground truth flow fields
render_depth_error_comparison: render depth error comparison visualizations between predicted and ground truth inverse depth maps
render_save_video_frames: render frames and save RGB, depth, and camera pose videos as MP4 files to disk
